objective: Define the minimal filelist-facing boundary that can produce a Verilator-like hybrid plan without claiming arbitrary RTL support.

boundary_decision.reason: The target-name plus --sim-accel-shape path is now validated through one non-dry-run execution. The next usability gap is accepting RTL source-file inputs and producing an explicit hybrid plan while still keeping unresolved design-discovery assumptions visible.

accepted_first_form.description: Repeatable --source file list plus explicit design metadata, dry-run only.
accepted_first_form.overlay: explicit coverage top overlay when the source filelist is not directly the coverage top
accepted_first_form.source_gate: explicit gate or planned gate that defines the coverage-output contract
accepted_first_form.coverage_manifest_path: explicit manifest path or generated manifest draft path
accepted_first_form.coverage_output_target: explicit compare target name for coverage_output_equivalence
accepted_first_form.clock_reset: explicit fields when defaults <top>__DOT__clk_i and <top>__DOT__reset_like_w are not correct
accepted_first_form.shape: not inferred by this boundary; later execution must still choose a shape such as 64x1
accepted_first_form.report_naming: explicit compare-report path or documented naming rule before execution

plan_outputs: Verilator build inputs: mdir, top module, source files, defines, args

refusal_cases: no source file and no overlay is provided
source or overlay path is untracked or outside the repository boundary
clock/reset fields cannot be made explicit or defaulted
coverage output words or manifest scope are unknown
the filelist cannot be mapped to a tracked template/gate draft without hidden local assumptions
the operator expects execution rather than plan-only dry-run evidence
the operator expects automatic optimal GPU allocation from this boundary

commands.expected_stderr: error: at least one --source or --overlay is required

non_claims: reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
